_comment: Recruitment cycle data. Events render left-to-right on the Recruitment page in array order and are exported to /sep-recruitment.ics (Google/Apple/Outlook). Dates are local Chapel Hill time (America/New_York): 'start'/'end' as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for timed events, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day (end = last day, inclusive). 'alsoOn' repeats a timed event on extra dates (same times). Set 'calendar': false to keep an item off the .ics. Source for Fall 2026: 'SEP Master Recruitment Plan - Fall 2026'. No FAQ section — keep copy minimal. See MAINTENANCE.md.
_applyUrl_note: Paste the application form link when it opens (Fri Aug 28); the Apply button hides while this is empty.
_todo: 'Bell' is the venue named in the plan for the interest events — replace with the full building/room name before publishing.
Game Night: the plan's calendar grid puts it on Mon Aug 24; the narrative section says Aug 25. Confirm with VP Recruitment.
Attire is not specified in the plan — add per event if the chapter wants it shown.
UBP Open House and Sole Fest dates were not released when the plan was written — add if SEP is tabling there.

events.name: Tabling around campus
events.description: Brothers are out tabling most days from FDOC through the first week of September. Come say hi and ask anything.

events.name: Interest Meeting
events.description: The first info session: what SEP is, how recruitment works, and a Q&A panel of current brothers. In person or on Zoom.

events.name: Speed Dating with Brothers
events.description: Quick one-on-one rotations so you meet as many brothers as possible.

events.name: Game Night
events.description: Board games with current members. Low-key, and the easiest way to see what the chapter is like.

events.name: Paint & Pass
events.description: Paint a canvas while brothers rotate through, add to it, and answer your questions.

events.name: Application opens
events.description: A short written application about you and your interest in entrepreneurship. Any major, any year. Experience is not required.

events.name: Résumé Workshop & Networking Night
events.description: Résumé tips for internships and recruiting, then Networking Bingo with the brothers.

events.name: Application closes
events.description: Last day to submit. Applications are reviewed by committee before formal recruitment.

events.name: Formal Recruitment
events.description: Two identical nights. Attend whichever works for you. Three rounds: a panel interview with exec, an elevator pitch, and a Shark-Tank-style pitch competition in pairs.

events.name: Decisions sent
events.description: Check your inbox. New members join the chapter at the first meeting on Thu Sep 17 in McColl.
